rationale: For an internal IPAM tool designed for IT admins, an authoritative, high-contrast, data-dense interface conveys precision and control. Monospace accents enhance the infrastructure/terminal aesthetic. We strictly avoid 'SaaS Purple' and gradient bloat, focusing heavily on legibility, grid systems, and functional status mapping.

layout.spacing_system: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) for structural containers, but dense spacing (gap-1, gap-2) for data lists and subnet maps.
layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid (MODE B): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Children h-full to stretch.
layout.subnet_map: Dense CSS Grid. w-3 h-3 md:w-4 md:h-4 blocks. Flat aesthetic with minimal gap (gap-[1px] or gap-1). Provide interactive tooltips on hover for IP details.

components.cards: Technical aesthetic: flat design, no soft drop-shadows. Use 1px solid border (border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800). Sharp edges or max rounded-md.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Primary CTA uses brand blue. Secondary uses transparent bg with explicit border. All buttons must have strong hover states.
components.tables: Dense rows. IP and Date columns MUST be font-mono. Status column uses color-coded dot + text. Left-aligned data.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to sharp edges (rounded-sm), clear borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-1.
components.badges: Technical labels. border border-current text-current bg-transparent px-2 py-0.5 rounded-none uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest font-mono.
components.sidebar_nav: Vertical layout. Subtle hover states (hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800). Selected states should have a bold left border (border-l-2 border-blue-500).

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle background shifts. No heavy lifting/translating on hover to maintain the solid, reliable technical feel.

images.instructions: Use on the login/register screen to provide a technical atmosphere. Apply heavy opacity overlay (bg-black/80 or bg-zinc-900/90) so it doesn't distract from the authentication form.
Use sparsely in 0-data states (like empty conflicts queue). Apply grayscale and opacity reduction.

testing.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Example: data-testid='ip-request-submit', data-testid='nav-admin-dashboard'

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize React project with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Install lucide-react.
2. Configure 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'IBM Plex Mono' in Tailwind config and import them via Google Fonts.
3. Set up Shadcn for Light and Dark modes. Map the provided custom hex colors to Tailwind CSS variables in index.css.
4. Build the Visual Subnet Map as a highly dense CSS Grid. Loop through network ranges (e.g., 256 for /24) to create grid cells. Each cell reflects its status color.
5. Do NOT use purple/violet colors anywhere. Avoid standard gradient backgrounds. Stick strictly to the defined status palette and blue primary accent.
6. Build a dashboard layout with a fixed sidebar and a main scrollable content area.
7. Format all IP addresses and MAC addresses using the 'font-mono' Tailwind class.
8. Apply data-testid attributes to all inputs, buttons, and row actions.
